title: Quality / Certifications
body: Certified and verified by leading food safety and quality institutions across the UK and internationally.

items.title: Food Hygiene Rating 5
items.desc: Awarded the top 5-Star 'Very Good' rating by the UK Food Standards Agency for flawless hygiene.

items.title: ISO 22000:2018
items.desc: International Food Safety Management System standard certifying our sterile cold-press chain.

items.title: Soil Association Organic
items.desc: 100% sustainably grown sugarcane harvested without synthetic pesticides or chemical fertilizers.

items.title: SALSA Accreditation
items.desc: Safe and Local Supplier Approval ensuring the highest operational integrity for UK artisans.

items.title: Zero Additives Lab Purity
items.desc: Independently lab tested for zero added water, refined sugars, artificial acids, or preservatives.

items.title: HACCP Certified Protocol
items.desc: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point protocol applied at every stage of extraction and serving.

items.title: Circular Zero-Waste Cane
items.desc: 100% of residual cane bagasse is repurposed into biodegradable tableware and clean bio-energy.

items.title: London Craft Guild Standard
items.desc: Accredited member of London's artisanal producers celebrating authentic heritage beverages.
